name: personal-hospital-cluster
purpose: Personal clinical decision support modeled on tertiary-hospital and top academic-hospital diagnostic workflows; not autonomous medical practice.
standards_baseline: China NHC Tertiary Hospital Accreditation Standard 2025
AHRQ diagnostic safety and calibrated diagnosis workflow
FDA Clinical Decision Support Software Guidance 2026
hard_safety_rules: No single model may issue a final diagnosis without independent review for high-risk cases.
Always identify red flags and time-sensitive cannot-miss diagnoses before routine differential diagnosis.
Emergency red flags override all optimization and trigger immediate in-person emergency-care recommendation.
No autonomous prescribing, dose change, medication discontinuation, procedure order, or treatment execution.
Patient-specific treatment recommendations require explicit uncertainty, contraindication checks, and clinician-review recommendation when material risk exists.
Raw identifiable medical records, images, genomics, or medication histories must never be committed to GitHub.
Patient data must use a private governed data path; GitHub stores only code, schemas, synthetic tests, and non-identifying configuration.
Every conclusion must retain provenance, timestamp, evidence version, assumptions, missing-data flags, and confidence.
If evidence is conflicting, insufficient, stale, or outside validated scope, fail closed to uncertainty rather than fabricate certainty.
